title: Evidence-led FreezeWatch exposure decision procedure
summary: Codifies the ordered Yes, Possible, Upstream and No decision procedure and applies it in a full-dataset FreezeWatch re-review, separating current holder-targeted powers from mutable direct controls and measured issuer/custodian exposure.
impact: Materiality is measured per deployment before failing closed; individually sub-threshold controlled deployments are disclosed but never aggregated to set a verdict.

Yes requires a current authority able to target arbitrary holders, including enforced allowlists, sanctions oracles, active exit gates and arbitrary-holder burns. Directly assigning a victim's denylist-state role is an active blacklist power; merely appointing an operator is not.

Global transfer pauses, all admin/DAO-upgradeable token implementations, grantable empty or incapable operator roles, dormant exit gates, material canonical-bridge burner surfaces and issuer-shipped consensus halts resolve to Possible unless an independent active holder-targeted control establishes Yes.

Upstream requires a qualifying parent claim, full CEX custody or strictly more than 50% measured issuer/custodian reserve exposure. Categorical collateral counting excludes DAO-only controls and includes custodial fiat, bank/fund/T-bill claims and allocated physical commodities.

CDP/lending reserve tests use debt-weighted exposure; reserve-backed tokens use published composition. LPs split by constituent value, with the coin and its own wrappers/savings-share legs only in the denominator; different tokens from the same issuer count at their own status. Unmeasurable reserves never establish Upstream.

The full-dataset re-review of all 397 active coins refreshes deployment, role, control and reserve evidence under the same procedure: 118 statuses change and the active buckets move from 288 Yes / 77 Upstream / 18 Possible / 14 No to 213 Yes / 55 Upstream / 109 Possible / 20 No. Most moves are Yes or Upstream to Possible for pause-only, upgrade-only or grantable-role tokens; 8 Yes move to Upstream, 7 Upstream move to No, and 4 coins move up to Yes on newly verified active controls.

Tracker configuration restores current PAXG freeze/unfreeze topics while preserving legacy history, corrects Avalanche USDT to its deployment-era indexed block/destroy family, and retires non-emitting Binance-Peg BSC and legacy Optimism USDT scans; the separate Optimism USDT0 scan remains.

Active parent/status consistency validation rejects No children of exposed declared parents and inherited children supported only by No parents without a separate qualifying reserve/custody candidate; this guard does not substitute for measuring the reserve threshold.

title: Canonical freeze identities and evidence-qualified totals
summary: FreezeWatch counts canonical accounts and logs once, separates caught-up coverage from bounded scan progress, and preserves unavailable USD valuations rather than reporting them as zero. Historical amount repair requires event-time quote attribution; current prices cannot value an old freeze event.
impact: Equivalent EVM log spellings and Tron account representations no longer duplicate public events, active counts, or snapshots. Newly persisted Tron addresses use validated lowercase 0x byte identities; Base58 remains a provider-call and display representation.

Numeric transaction-local lifecycle ordering replaces lexical ordering. Cross-transaction lifecycle and amount ordering must be proven by chain evidence; missing or contradictory evidence remains ambiguous rather than manufacturing an active state or amount.

An EVM or Tron scan that makes bounded progress but has not reached its observed safe frontier is incomplete. It cannot advance success clocks or publish a fresh producer summary as if coverage were caught up.

Tron historical balance replay validates the decimal-scaled token amount rather than rejecting ordinary 18-decimal raw balances solely because they exceed JavaScript's safe integer range; genuinely excessive scaled amounts remain inadmissible.

Budget-skipped and order-withheld snapshot work is retained as durable debt for maintenance retries. Operator snapshot admission obeys execution and ambiguity evidence instead of transaction-hash order.

Unknown event-time and current USD values remain unavailable. Mixed aggregates publish known subtotals with partial valuation coverage; all canonical tracked gold cohorts, including XAUM, contribute when observed.

Historical non-USD repair recovers native amounts but keeps USD unavailable without an event-time quote. A gold zero substitution carries explicit provenance and is not treated as a failed observation or silently substituted for one.
RPC block timestamps are admitted only when the returned block hash matches the event's block evidence, preventing a different block generation from supplying event time.

Blacklistability classifications and scan cadence are unchanged. Fixed-clock identity, ordering, valuation, and coverage comparison remains a release prerequisite; no production replay or runtime-health result is claimed.
Activation is provisionally 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC (1791676800); re-date effectiveAt at release

title: Confirmed Tron transaction ordering
summary: Resolves same-block Tron state transitions using confirmed block transaction positions, while retaining explicit uncertainty when chain evidence is unavailable.
impact: Confirmed Tron block-array positions are persisted separately from transaction-local event indices; neither transaction hashes nor provider event order imply execution order.
A bounded, serial maintenance pass repairs both retained and newly ingested conflicting events without rewinding scan cursors.
Missing positions keep tron-cross-transaction-order and remain excluded from confirmed active counts. Proved freeze-then-destroy records remain blacklisted but contribute no active frozen amount.
Historical event-time amounts and retained freeze-ledger balances keep their existing independent evidence requirements.

title: Execution-order state and durable malformed-log quarantine
summary: Orders EVM state transitions by block-global log position and explicitly withholds ambiguous Tron state. Malformed required fields receive three scan observations before durable quarantine.
impact: Timestamp, block number, numeric log index, and array suffix replace lexical transaction-hash ordering across state folds, SQL history selection, and ledger rebuilds.
Same-block Tron events across transactions do not imply a known order; affected records are excluded from confirmed active counts and reported as tron-cross-transaction-order.

Missing or invalid direction bools, address arrays, addresses, and log identities hold the frontier for up to three distinct scans, then retain source evidence and a named decode-retry-exhausted disposition in durable storage.
A valid empty address array remains a complete observation; unknown event-time amounts remain separate from required state evidence.

title: Canonical reviewed exposure status
summary: Makes the sourced blacklistability review the sole product-level FreezeWatch status authority, removing the parallel authored override and runtime inference path without changing current classifications.
impact: `blacklistabilityReview.reviewedStatus` is now the only authored Yes, Upstream, Possible, or No verdict
The generated client-registry `blacklistStatus` is a direct projection of that verdict for FreezeWatch, Report Cards, coverage views, and Selector data
Safety Score V9 continues to consume the same review for evidence and scoring, but its access projection is no longer a fallback product-status source
All 404 tracked stablecoin classifications are unchanged by the migration
